title: Does the job & I like the low key look of them
text:
Does the job & I like the low key look of them. Don’t judge these hooks by the way they hold my curtains back. I’m using two black panels and 2 cream sheet panels, so although each curtain hook is holding back 4 panels, with the black curtains being double layered fabric.
With that being said, for $10 these are a fantastic deal. Sturdy and came with the hardware to install.
